name: @hydranium/client-vscode
description: Cross-head VS Code client primitives for a hydranium host: the extension host asks the language server for each socket head's port, bounded, and registers the host commands through which a Theia app that sideloads the extension reaches those ports.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const m=require('./package.json'),fs=require('node:fs');const missing=[m.main,...Object.values(m.bin||{})].filter(entry=>entry&&!fs.existsSync(entry));if(missing.length){console.error('prepack '+m.name+': not built ('+missing.join(', ')+' missing). Run the build before packing: a files entry that matches nothing is skipped silently, so the tarball would ship src only.');process.exit(1);}"

//prepack: The publish guard, a `prepack` rather than a `prepare`: `prepack` runs only when a tarball is made (`npm pack`, `npm publish`) and never on install, so it cannot break the install it has no business touching. What it defends against: `files` lists `lib`, `lib` is gitignored, and a `files` entry matching nothing is skipped SILENTLY — so `npm publish` from an unbuilt tree emits a tarball of `src` and nothing else, with no error.
